note_en: Be careful with 倍 in growth figures: 增长了一点五倍 means "grew by 1.5 times," i.e., up 150 percent (to 2.5 times the original), while 是…的四倍 means "is four times as much as." Also note 分别 "respectively": 笔数和金额分别…增长了约百分之十七和百分之十一 "the number and value grew by about 17 and 11 percent respectively."
